answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents can be enforced through a unique, non-fungible identity token, akin to a digital yarrow, which must be staked per agent. Each token's embedded, unalterable pigment signifies its authenticity. An attacker creating multiple fake identities must acquire an equivalent number of these scarce tokens, an economic hurdle steep as a knoll. This escalating capital requirement makes large-scale Sybil attacks prohibitively costly.
